values.text: Our customers spent 2026 growing their audiences and their businesses. Here are the highlights, and your own dashboard is ready when you are.
Our customers reached readers in 190 countries this year.
More customers went international with text messages.
On average, each customer earned $8,420 from email this year.
Customers added 210 million new contacts between them.
Customers ran 96,330 A/B tests on subject lines and content.
More emails went out in November than in any other month.
The full report, and the features behind it, can help you plan the year ahead.
These figures are illustrative samples. Replace them with your own before sending.
